<objective>
Human-judged acceptance sign-off skill — the far-end mirror of the inception BRD. Reads the engagement's inception brd.md + gaps.md, walks a human through user-acceptance testing one item at a time (ACCEPT / REJECT / CHANGES_REQUESTED), captures one overall decision plus the signer, writes a per-engagement signoff.md, and records a single execution_outcome node via uat_signoff. The human is the authority — it never runs an LLM verdict, never derives ship authority, and never blocks. Advisory / record-only.

Phases:

- resolve: Resolve the engagement slug and read docs/inception/<engagement>/brd.md + gaps.md; assemble the acceptance checklist (BRD functional requirements / success criteria + resolved and open gaps). Soft-degrade to a supplied checklist when the basis is thin and record what is missing.
- interview: Present each acceptance item to the human one at a time (plain-text choice), capturing ACCEPT / REJECT / CHANGES_REQUESTED plus a note verbatim. Never infer a disposition.
- verdict: Ask the human for one overall decision (ACCEPTED / REJECTED / CHANGES_REQUESTED) and the signer identity; read back and confirm before recording.
- record: Write docs/inception/<engagement>/signoff.md (resolved-vs-rejected + signer + timestamp) and persist one execution_outcome node via uat_signoff (source uat-signoff, result derived from the overall decision). Advisory / record-only — blocks nothing.
  </objective>
